A cache entry produced by the real v0.9.1 `transcribe.py` (git tag v0.9.1),
frozen so 1.x can be tested against what 0.9.1 actually wrote rather than
against what 1.x thinks it wrote. Paths inside `entry/meta.json` point at
`/tmp/audio-tldr-fixture`, the neutral cache root used when generating it.
Do not regenerate with a newer version.

`clip.mp3`: 20 seconds of chapter 1 of the LibriVox recording of 孫子兵法
(https://archive.org/details/art_of_war_chinese_1506_librivox), public domain
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/).
